faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHS Tiruchirappalli Health Inspector recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DHS Tiruchirappalli Health Inspector posts is 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Health Inspector post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies announced for the Health Inspector position by the District Health Society Tiruchirappalli.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed plus two with Biology or Botany and Zoology, and Tamil as a subject in 10th level, along with a specific 2-year training course.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Health Inspector position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Health Inspector post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Health Inspector role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 17,500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the DHS Tiruchirappalli Health Inspector jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Health Society Tiruchirappalli (DHS Tiruchirappalli).

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 1900/A5/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Tiruchirappalli district, which is https://tiruchirappalli.nic.in/.
